style.styleTitle: Personalised Family Christmas Signpost Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised Christmas wooden signpost, enclosed in a clear glass bauble and hung on a velvet ribbon. Featuring the wooden signpost in a snowy winter scene, the bauble is the perfect addition to the family Christmas tree this year. The signpost design consists of a candy-cane style pole, a small top sign, and directional arrows. The top sign and arrows can be personalised with your choice of wording. The signpost sits in a flurry of artificial snow, encased in a glass bauble. Baubles measure 10cm and are finished with velvet ribbon in your choice of colour. Dimensions(mm): Height: 110 Width: 110 Depth: 110.
